name: The Almanac: Trades, Callings & Mastery
description: Identity-first trade progression for the modded world. Twenty-two domains, ranks from Novice to Grandmaster, earned by practice and never by grind: the day's work settles into your hands at rest. Requires The Almanac: Illuminated (0.1.4 or newer). Integrates with Smithing Plus or Smithing++ when either is installed, and runs without them. Part of The Almanac line.
